macro.text: Fed's Musalem and Logan signaled more rate hikes may be needed to fight inflation
Gold fell to its lowest level in a year even as Iran tensions simmered
China's factory PMI contracted at its fastest pace in three months in October

Alaska's contested Senate race could decide control of the chamber for Republicans

corporate.note: Shares posted their worst day since the 1970s, erasing about $140B as PC demand and AI chip supply worries mount
Shares logged their biggest one-day drop ever after search referral traffic fell sharply in Q3
Stock slid in sympathy with Intel on fears of weak PC demand and AI chip capacity constraints
S&P Global cut its outlook to negative citing heavy capex and free-cash-flow pressure
OpenAI reportedly cut its funding target by $10 billion amid the broader tech selloff
Alaska Air to cut about 200 jobs as fuel costs squeeze earnings
Set to join the S&P 500, replacing Kenvue, in an index-flow boost
Seen pulling ahead in the cloud race, with analysts framing it as Wall Street's new favorite

frontPage.watch: Tech selloff momentum and Fed hawkish commentary set the tone, with AI capex worries still dominating sentiment.

esForecast.footnote: Ranges cover the full ~23-hour futures session, not just the New York cash session. Sample 3729 sessions from 2012-01-01. Model: ln(next range %) = -5.856 + 0.974×ln(VIX) + 0.312×ln(ATR5 %), R² 54%. Out-of-sample band hit rate 47%. On FOMC, payrolls and CPI days the range is raised 23%, 15% and 6% (how much bigger those sessions ran than the model, 2012-2026).
